title: QR Transfers: Complete Guide
summary: This document explains how to complete QR transfers end to end, including timing, confirmation, and limits: $1,250 per QR payment, $3,000 daily cap, and 17-minute QR validity. It also covers what happens when “Yes” confirmation applies and how to handle expired codes (regenerate, don’t use screenshots).
